name: edgar-mcp
install:
if ! python3 -m venv --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv; fi
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -U pip
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi

terminals.name: MCP HTTP
terminals.description: EDGAR MCP Streamable HTTP server. Health at http://127.0.0.1:8000/health, MCP at /mcp.
